metadata.description: Open-source agent skills for Medical Affairs professionals.

plugins.name: medical-affairs-skills
plugins.description: Give an AI agent a Medical Affairs job, not a prompt. KOL engagement briefs, field insight synthesis, congress intelligence, publication strategy, medical planning, evidence gap analysis, medical information responses, plus deck/manuscript/poster/figure generation. Ships working PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov and openFDA clients and will not emit a citation it has not resolved.
